clip.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 UGC-style fashion try-on video for social media, 15 seconds, four quick cuts, natural phone-camera look, bright warm apartment with wood floors, an arched mirror and soft daylight. The presenter is an AI-generated young adult woman (not any real person), friendly and excited, speaking English directly to the camera. Clear natural speech, light room tone, no background music, no on-screen text, no logos.
The dress in every shot is the exact caramel cable-knit mock neck midi sweater dress from the reference images: plain-knit fitted top with a mock neck, long sleeves with ribbed cuffs, a ribbed waistband at the natural waist, a vertical cable-knit skirt fitted through the hips with a diagonal wrap seam that opens into a front slit, midi length to mid-calf where the hem overlaps the top of black knee-high boots. Keep its caramel color, the cable pattern (on the skirt only), the slit position and height (never higher than in the references) and the length identical to the references.
Shot 1 (0-3 s): the presenter (shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, small gold hoop earrings) is already wearing the caramel dress with black knee-high boots; full-length shot, she takes two steps toward the camera so the front slit opens over the boots, looking straight into the lens, saying: "Own knee-high boots? This dress is for you."
Shot 2 (3-7 s): cut to a mid-shot; her hands run down the cable-knit skirt and smooth the ribbed waistband, then touch the mock neck; her eyes follow her hands, saying: "Cable knit, mock neck, fitted through the hips."
Shot 3 (7-11 s): cut to a full-length side-front shot; she walks past the arched mirror and the front slit opens over the boot shaft with each step, saying: "The slit opens over your boots, so walking's easy."
Shot 4 (11-15 s): she walks up to the camera into a smiling chest-up close-up, saying: "It's Ember and Clove, fifty-two ninety-nine. Link's right here."
